[[Purified Rift Essence]] is an {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} [[crafting material]] obtained by [[crafting]]. It is used as crafting material for the legendary ring [[Endless Summer]] as well as a currency to purchase pieces of the [[Astral Ward armor]] and the [[Oneiros-Spun armor]].

It can be reverted back to an amalgamated rift essence and a mystic clover by purchasing a [[Box of Purified Rift Essence Components]] from [[Rift Researcher Adam]] in [[Lowland Shore]] (requires ''[[Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds]]'').
